entries.zh: 祈祷（向上帝祈求）
entries.en: to pray to God

entries.zh: 祈祝（祈求祝告）
entries.en: to pray and invoke (God)

entries.zh: 祈求（恳切祈望而求）
entries.en: to pray for; to implore

entries.zh: 祷告（向神祈求）
entries.en: to pray (to God)

entries.zh: 祷祝（祷告祝告）
entries.en: to pray and invoke

entries.zh: 祝告（向上帝或诸圣祝祷祈告）
entries.en: to pray to God or to the saints

entries.zh: 恳求（恳切请求）
entries.en: to beg earnestly; to press a plea

entries.zh: 恳求切（恳切至极、再三哀求）
entries.en: to beg most urgently; to press a plea to the utmost

entries.zh: 鉴纳（祈神鉴察纳受所求）
entries.en: to pray the idol to look upon and accept (the petition)
entries.notes: M 栏标 [残]，据 L（向偶像祈求）与汉字「鑒納」推得释义

entries.zh: 求嗣（祈求子嗣）
entries.en: to pray for offspring; to seek an heir
entries.notes: M 栏标 [残]，据汉字「求嗣」与 L 求告语境推得释义

entries.zh: 求乞（乞求人给与、讨施舍）
entries.en: to beg that something be given; to ask for alms

entries.zh: 恳切催求以求成事；兼指估讨物价、议定成交
entries.en: to press a request earnestly until granted; to bargain and settle a price
entries.notes: 汉字「估成」与 encareçimiento 之对应依赖词义推断：17 世纪 encarecer 兼有「恳切催求」与「抬价议定」二义，取马尼拉贸易语境并存两义

entries.zh: 苦求（苦苦哀求）
entries.en: to beg bitterly; to plead hard

entries.zh: 觅解（寻求和解、托人排解说情）
entries.en: to seek mediation or reconciliation; to beg that (the parties) be friends again
entries.notes: M 栏记号污损难辨（T99），据汉字「覓解」与 L「求其修好」推得释义

entries.zh: 转托（转请他人代为求告）
entries.en: to ask another to intercede; to entrust one's petition to another

entries.zh: 缠脚缠手（缠住不放、纠缠哀求）
entries.en: to cling and pester persistently in begging
entries.notes: L 栏标 [残]（ata ſe ſo 段难辨读），据汉字「纏腳纏手」推得释义

entries.zh: 谄求（以好言谄媚哀求；首字原稿难辨）
entries.en: to beg with flattering words
entries.notes: 汉字首字原件存「諳/諂」之疑，据 L「用好话恳求」判定为谄求

entries.zh: 婉曲（婉转其辞、耐心柔声恳求）
entries.en: to plead gently and tactfully, with patience and affection

entries.zh: 央请、央托（请人代为求告；为双方恳托说项）
entries.en: to ask someone to intercede; to entreat on behalf of both parties

entries.zh: 咳嗽；伤风流涕（感冒鼻塞之疾）
entries.en: cough; head cold, catarrh (romadizo)

entries.zh: 鼻塞（鼻窍堵塞不通）
entries.en: stuffy nose; nasal congestion
entries.notes: L 词头 nomadico 与 M 栏均标 [残] 且污损（T99），西语词头难辨（疑与上条 romadizo 同属风寒鼻塞类疾），据汉字「鼻塞」推得释义；旁圈小注未能确认
